section.raw_text:
| Feature | ES5 | ES2021 |
| ------- | --- | ------ |
| Variables | `var x = 1` | `let x = 1; const y = 2` |
| Functions | `function f() {}` | `const f = () => {}` |
| Strings | `"Hi " + name` | `` `Hi ${name}` `` |
| Objects | `{x: x}` | `{x}` |
| Classes | `function F() {}` + prototype | `class F {}` |
| Modules | `require`/`module.exports` | `import`/`export` |
| Async | callbacks | `async`/`await` |
| Defaults | `a |  |
| Optional access | `a && a.b && a.b.c` | `a?.b?.c` |
